targets.note: Statement only (Prop-valued def); not proved, per authoring rules.
TFAE of the four equivalent conditions; statement only, not proved.
Part (1): exponent rigidity over a characteristic-zero field; statement only, not proved.
Part (2): exponent rigidity over C in the formal and analytic settings; statement only, not proved.

notes: No sorry / admit / axiom used anywhere in the library.

Opaque abstract carrier types (Sch, AnGerm, FormalGerm) are introduced via NonemptyType so their guaranteed inhabitant comes from a proof, not an axiom; bodyless opaque values/maps that land in these types are declared `noncomputable opaque` and dependent type defs `noncomputable`.

Concrete algebraic layer (exponent tuples, permutation equivalence, Brieskorn polynomial, B_{a,k} as a k-algebra) is modelled directly in Mathlib; the geometric/analytic/formal layer is opaque because Mathlib lacks the separated-k-variety, good Gm-action, C*-variety, complex analytic germ, and formal/algebroid germ APIs used by the paper.
Target theorems thm:mainA, thm:mainB, thm:mainC are recorded as Prop-valued statement defs and are intentionally not proved.

Gap: Theorem C(2)'s formal-completion ring isomorphism (\hat B_a) is represented by the opaque relation FormalRingIso rather than a concrete MvPowerSeries quotient, to avoid asserting an unverified concrete construction; this is a source/library gap, not a change of the paper claim.
